name: Atomic

identity.oneLiner: Mid-century atomic optimism: kidney shapes, starbursts, teal–coral–mustard.
identity.summary: Atomic / MCM blends boomerang curves with compact geometric type. Warm wood-adjacent neutrals, saturated accent triads, and playful but sparse starburst ornaments. Dialect switches MCM softness vs sharper Atomic.
identity.authenticityNotes: Motifs are few and large. Avoid 1950s clip-art overload; color triad and soft organic radius do most of the work.

axes.shape: Organic radii + boomerang-friendly asymmetry; kidney cards at high fidelity
axes.edge: Soft borders or borderless tonal separation
axes.surface: Warm matte pigments; light paper/wood grain only at high fidelity
axes.elevation: Soft lifted cards; occasional hard offset shadow (print-like)
axes.ornament: Starburst / atom rings in ornament slots; sparse
axes.typeVoice: Geometric sans; friendly titles; slightly wide tracking
axes.motion: Breezy ease; gentle float — never violent bounce

bands.description: Structure hints only: radius, type voice, subtle edge. No ornaments.
Clear era geometry and materials; sparse ornaments on surfaces.
Full decorative program. Demo/showcase territory; neverDo still binds.

dialects.label: MCM
dialects.description: Softer organic radii, warmer wood neutrals.

neverDo: Never wallpaper every surface with starbursts.
Never use distressed Western wood type or comic balloons.
Never let coral/teal accents carry contrast alone on small text.
Never apply kidney clip-paths to dense form controls (inputs stay rectangular enough to use).
Do not mix synthwave neon grids into Atomic.

lines: shape: organic radii / kidney at high fidelity
never: motif wallpaper, neon grids on forms
